public.text: Configurable probabilistic and deterministic matching is required, but no minimum performance, evaluation, explainability, subgroup testing, or quality-monitoring expectations are stated.
public.suggestedRevision: Require context-specific thresholds for false matches and missed matches, representative evaluation, subgroup analysis, explainable match evidence, human adjudication, monitoring, and periodic recalibration.
